alternate_names: Omkareshwar Mandir, Jawahar Nagar (per map listings)

history.summary: A local neighbourhood Shiva temple at Omkareshwar Mandir chowk, Jawahar Nagar Road, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar (Aurangabad), Maharashtra. It is NOT the Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga (which is on Narmada island in Madhya Pradesh) and NOT the Peshwa-era Omkareshwar temple in Pune. No reliable published history, founding date, or builder could be found for this local mandir — identity confirmed only from map listings and photos of the local shrine. History UNVERIFIED.

name: Omkareshwar Mahadev Mandir
town_description: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, formerly Aurangabad, is a major city in the Marathwada region of Maharashtra, serving as its administrative and industrial hub. It is the gateway to the UNESCO World Heritage caves of Ajanta and Ellora, the Daulatabad Fort, and the Bibi Ka Maqbara. Founded in the early 17th century and later capital of the Deccan under Aurangzeb, the city was officially renamed Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in 2023.

travel.railway: Aurangabad railway station, ~5 km (verify); Manmad is a larger junction ~80 km away
travel.road: Within the city, off Jawahar Nagar Road; well connected by city bus/auto
